summary: Funselektor Labs' stylized driving games, moving from minimalist drift training in Absolute Drift to the alternate-history rally celebration Art of Rally.

primary.why: Art of Rally released first on Windows, macOS, and Linux in 2020, later on Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Switch, PS4, PS5, iOS, and Android. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most update-friendly route for the top-down rally game and its added Kenya/Indonesia/Australia-era content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with all free updates and owned DLC installed; use current consoles for living-room play and mobile only for portable access.
